name: effect-parry-freeze-sparks
title: Parry Time Slice
description: Hai lưỡi kiếm vung vào nhau, chạm nhau thì thời gian khựng 0.3 giây với hai vạch ngang và tia sáng bốn cánh; rồi hai lưỡi bật ra có rung, chín tia lửa xoè lên và rơi theo trọng lực.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-impact-fx-parry-time-slice, written here): px @320x200. Two blades (pivots 120 px apart) swing −0.35 → 0.785 rad (mirrored) to contact in 370 ms in-cubic (0.25-0.62 s); freeze 300 ms: two horizontal lines ±6 px grow to ±150 px in 120 ms outCubic, 4-point star spark r 18. Then they deflect to −0.62 rad in 450 ms outExpo with wobble 0.08 e^(−6t) sin(30t) rad; the star shrinks in 350 ms. 9 sparks fan upward ±73° (±6° seeded) at 90-150 px/s, y += 200·t² (400 px/s²), 6 px streaks, fading over 600 ms. Params: contactAt: lúc chạm (0.62 s) · freeze: khựng (0.3 s) · deflect: bật ra (0.45 s) · sparks: số tia (9) · gravity: trọng lực (400 px/s²).
